extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of philosophy (metaphysics, epistemology), scholars of 19th-century German philosophy
extracted.subtask_description: An excerpt from a philosophical work (metaphysics/epistemology) presenting arguments about materialism, the nature of matter, will as thing-in-itself, necessity vs. freedom, and the unity of the will. Intended as an argumentative exposition rather than a prescriptive rubric.
